name: Flask notes API
description: A notes API with SQL built from input, pickle and unsafe YAML loading, a shell backup command, debug mode and a hard-coded token. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Several high and medium findings in one file; the file-path read in /export is not flagged by the scanner (a known miss).

fixes.title: Read the admin token from the environment
fixes.explanation: The token is no longer in the repository (rotate the exposed value).

fixes.title: Turn debug mode off
fixes.explanation: Debug mode exposes an interactive debugger and stack traces.

fixes.title: Parameterize the search query
fixes.explanation: The search term is passed as a bound parameter instead of being formatted into the SQL text.
edits:
query = f"SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE '%{term}%'"
    cur.execute(query)
cur.execute("SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE ?", (f"%{term}%",))

fixes.title: Parse JSON instead of unpickling
fixes.explanation: pickle.loads can execute code embedded in the data; JSON cannot.

fixes.title: Use yaml.safe_load
fixes.explanation: safe_load builds only plain data types.

fixes.title: Run tar with an argument list
fixes.explanation: No shell parses the input, so metacharacters in the target are not interpreted.
